nodes.text:
The Indian Council of Medical Research has confirmed 2 cases of HMPV in Karnataka, through routine surveillance. Both cases, detected at Bengaluruwere identified as part of ICMR’s ongoing monitoring of respiratory illnesses across the country.
#2 case of HMPV in India
